evidence.correctness: Independent GS1 mod-10 (GS1 General Specifications 7.9.1, written by the auditor in the probe script) agrees with computeCheck on 100,000 random 7/11/12/13-digit bodies (0 disagreements). Hand-worked body 400638133393 -> 1 matches; ISBN-10 080442957X -> 9780804429573 (ISO 2108 mod-11 then 978 + mod-10) matches; UPC-E 01234543 -> 012340000053 matches the GS1 zero-suppression table. Both high-severity wrong outputs of 2026-11-12 are gone: 1.0009E+11 is sci-lost, and GTIN-14 forms of ordinary German/UK EAN-13s no longer raise restricted-prefix warnings. Remaining wrong outputs on arrival are medium/low: the UPC-E/GTIN-8 ambiguity is silent and 980/RCN-8 codes pass without a finding.
evidence.completeness: Claimed features re-run: check digits with swap hint, leading zeros, sci expansion and sci-lost, duplicates across forms, ISBN-10, UPC-E expansion, GTIN-14 case-pack linking, write-back. All work as listed; README 'Known gaps' honestly listed the four defects still open on arrival. 41 tests on arrival.
evidence.verification: node --test '*.test.mjs' in ventures/gtin-list-check: 41 pass, 0 fail on arrival. Four mutants via quality_mutate.py: the 04 rule (calc.mjs:151), UPC-E g=4 layout (calc.mjs:38) and sci guard lost > 0 -> lost > 1 (calc.mjs:108) all SURVIVED; GTIN-14 body slice removed (calc.mjs:202) caught. 3 of 4 survive, the same three as on 2026-11-12: the fix PR added tests for the cases it fixed only. After PR #18548: 48 pass and all three are caught.
evidence.craft: Read calc.mjs (284 lines on arrival), calc.test.mjs, index.html. Still pure and dependency-free, tests against the shipped module. The duplicated delimiter ranking (calc.mjs:54-55) remained on arrival (cleaned in PR #18548). Fix for GTIN-14 prefixes is a one-line slice with a comment; acceptable to a senior JS reviewer.
evidence.claims: No-upload claim backed by page.test.mjs (pass). Disclaimer and 'read from memory of public GS1 specifications' present. The high-severity claim failure (sci 'the check digit confirms it' for rounded values) is gone. Remaining: README:5 'restored only when the check digit proves it' and FAQ 'the check digit confirms it' overstate mod-10 (a low overclaim); page list of prefixes omitted 980. Known gaps section disclosed the open defects, so a reader was not misled about them.
evidence.fitness: Walked the job again with a PIM-style GTIN-14 export (04006381333931, 05000159484695, 20036000291456) and a sci-notation cell: no false prefix warnings, no fabricated code in the repaired file. A catalogue specialist can now use it for UPC/EAN/GTIN-14 lists; North American UPC-E data still leaves about 1 in 10 short codes silently as GTIN-8 on arrival.
evidence.domain: Against GS1 General Specifications: mod-10, GTIN-14 indicator semantics (prefix read after the indicator), UPC-E table and Bookland conversion now right. Departures on arrival: an 8-digit string valid as both GTIN-8 and UPC-E is not reported as ambiguous although a 0-prefixed GTIN-8 is an RCN-8 (GS1-8 prefixes 0 and 2) and the UPC-E reading is the likely one in North American data; 980 refund receipts not flagged.

defects.what: An 8-digit code valid as both GTIN-8 and UPC-E (01234565) is kept as an RCN-8 GTIN-8 with no warning and is not matched against its UPC-A form (carried over from prior defect 2).
Three of four seeded mutants in core logic survive (04 rule, UPC-E g=4, sci guard at one lost digit): the fix PR #15073 tested only what it fixed, so prior defect 3 stayed open.
980 refund receipts and GTIN-8 prefixes 0 and 2 (RCN-8) are not flagged: 9800000000007 and 20123451 give no finding.
Decimal-comma scientific notation ('4,006381333931E+12') is reported as non-digit characters.
README:5 'restored only when the check digit proves it' and the FAQ 'the check digit confirms it' present a 9-in-10 check as proof.
repair() drops all-empty rows and rewrites CRLF as LF, though it documents untouched rows as left exactly as they were.

verdict: Does not meet the bar on arrival (verification 2; correctness 3, claims 3, median 3); finished (completeness 3). Re-audit of the 2026-11-12 file, whose 9 defects were all counted fixed by the blanket fix_prs rule: on arrival 3 were closed (both highs: rounded scientific notation is never 'confirmed', GTIN-14 prefixes read after the indicator; and the README test command), 2 were partial and 4 were still open, the same four the README's own Known gaps listed. The mod-10 core remains exact (0 disagreements in 100,000 random bodies against an independent implementation). The binding gap is verification: the same three seeded mutants survived as on 2026-11-12, because the fix PR tested only the two bugs it fixed. PR #18548 fixes the six open or partial defects, adds seven tests and kills all three mutants (48 tests pass); a later round should re-audit before the score moves.
